headline: Executive order directs the federal government to improve access to its services for people who have limited ability to speak or read English.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order aims to make federal services easier to use for people with limited English skills. Executive orders like this typically direct federal agencies to review how they serve these people and to set up ways to help them, such as interpreters or translated materials. No official summary was provided, so details about specific requirements are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: They may find it easier to get information and services from the federal government in a language they understand.
They are expected to take steps to improve access to their services for people with limited English skills.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 11, 2000; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
